headline: Sales and profit rise but per-share earnings dip
summary_short: Revenue was CNY 4,619M, up 9.3% q/q, and net income rose 7.5% to CNY 212M, though EPS fell 13.4% to CNY 0.97.
summary_long: Gross profit grew 7.8% q/q to CNY 485M and operating income grew 9.0% to CNY 343M. Gross profit margin was about 10.5%, versus about 10.6% in the prior quarter. EPS fell even as net income rose, so the two series likely differ in basis. No prior-year comparison is on the shard.
